title: Reviews
intro: What customers said after collecting their orders. A short reply goes a long way, especially on a low rating.

toast.alreadyReplied: You already replied to this review.

form.label: Your reply, shown under the review
form.placeholder: Thank you for coming by, {{name}}. We will pack the order carefully next time.

empty.title: No reviews yet
empty.text: A customer can review your stall and what they bought once their order is completed (D-10).

note: Reviews cannot be removed or edited by the stall. Reply once — it stays with the review.

spoiled.intro: Customers can report produce that spoiled soon after pickup. Reply with what you know; an admin decides.
spoiled.emptyText: When a customer reports produce from one of your orders, it shows here for you to reply.
spoiled.replyPlaceholder: How it was kept, what you saw when you packed it.
spoiled.alreadyDecided: An admin has already decided on this report.
spoiled.strikesText: A confirmed report on an extended shelf life is a strike. 3 strikes in 90 days lock longer shelf lives.
spoiled.lockTitle: Longer shelf lives are locked until {{date}}
spoiled.lockText: Until then your products can only use the suggested shelf life.
